'''Daisuke Kishio''' (Japanese: '''岸尾大輔''' ''Kishio Daisuke'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}. He was born on March 28, 1974 in {{wp|Matsusaka, Mie|Matsusaka}}, {{wp|Mie Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}.

He is a member of Tokyo Actor's Consumer's Cooperative Society, and has been nominated for "Best Actor in a Leading role", "Best Actor in a Supporting Role", and "Best Radio Personality" after the second voice actor Awards.

==Pokémon roles==
Kishio has had various roles throughout the series, mainly voicing [[Character of the day|characters of the day]].
